rules.name: Caustica mod runtime (Minecraft Java client)
rules.comment: Caustica is a Vulkan ray-traced renderer mod for Minecraft Fabric. It runs in the Fabric/Mojang launcher JVM (java), and the main render thread + worker pool are sensitive to context-switch latency. Pin them to SCHED_BATCH with cgroup io-priority 1, and lift the cgroup CPU shares to 8000 so ananicy-cpp's "game" class wins against background services. (ananicy-cpp-game-ruleset is the upstream name in CachyOS / games-ruleset.)

rules.name: Caustica NGX / FSR / XeSS native shims
rules.comment: The mod dlopens libngxshim.so, libamd_fidelityfx_*.so, and libxess.so at runtime. They are loaded into the same JVM process so ananicy's process-name match (java) catches them — no separate rule needed. Listed here for visibility.

rules.name: Minecraft JVM (caustic argmatch)
rules.comment: Backup rule for the launcher case where ananicy's process-tree is broken (e.g. the launcher wraps java in a separate PGID). Match on the `-Dfabric.mods.dir` or `-Dcaustica.*` flags so we catch the right java instance even when the launcher is just 'java'.
